responsibility: This installed header implements the AArch64 Advanced SIMD/NEON intrinsic API exposed to user programs. It defines the NEON scalar and vector typedefs, helper macros, and thousands of always-inline wrappers that translate ACLE NEON function names and lane operations into the underlying AArch64 SIMD builtins, including later extensions such as BF16, dot-product, and matrix-multiply forms where available under appropriate target options.
